data.one_liner: Visualizes and highlights human body parts with heatmap intensity levels and body charts.
data.what_it_does: Provides BodyHeatmap and BodyChart widgets to render human anatomy graphics. Highlights specific body parts based on selected sets or intensity values for fitness, medical, or tracking apps.
use_when: You are building a fitness or workout app to show targeted muscle groups.
You need to visualize medical or anatomy data mapped to human body parts.
You want to display a heatmap of body part activity or injury intensity.
avoid_when: You need standard line, bar, pie charts, or gauges instead of anatomical graphics.
You require complex 3D human body models.
strengths: Includes ready-to-use widgets for both binary body part selection and intensity heatmaps.
Customizable colors, legend alignment, and intensity levels.
Supports front, back, and both view types.
weaknesses: Limited strictly to predefined human body parts and views.
Does not support generic chart types like lines or bars.
data.minimal_example:
BodyChart(
  selectedParts: {"chest", "arm", "abs", "back", "butt"},
  selectedColor: Colors.green,
  unselectedColor: Colors.grey.shade300,
  viewType: BodyViewType.both,
  width: 250,
)
